summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of VISITA Web Portal. All 23 pytest cases passed (auth for 4 roles, counters, referral full lifecycle including PDF upload/download/mark-faxed, prescription/appointment/imaging/message workflows with patient-facing status masking, patient verification with HCN masking, internal tasks/intercom, admin settings RBAC). Frontend Playwright verified login for patient/staff/physician, patient portal tiles + non-emergency notice, staff hub counter tiles with correct baseline numbers (rx=3, referrals=2, imaging=1, messages=4, appts=6 [baseline 5 + 1 from tests], doctor_tasks=2, verifications=2), referral queue with Open PDF/Download/Mark-as-Faxed buttons, physician hub with Referral Drop-Off entry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting internal routes (referrals/tasks/verifications) into separate routers for maintainability.

CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' default (from env). This is a browser-level error if the env variable is not set to explicit origins in production; not blocking now since auth uses Bearer tokens not cookies, but should be tightened.
Counters endpoint runs 7 sequential count_documents calls per request - could be parallelised with asyncio.gather for performance under load.
UpdateBody is a shared Pydantic model used for many endpoints with many Optional fields; consider per-endpoint models for stricter validation and clearer contracts.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all listed credentials verified working
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ prefixed patient/rx/appointment/imaging/message/task/referral records; not cleaned up but non-blocking. Registered dummy patient via /auth/register with random email prefix test_reg_*.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_visita_api.py (pytest, junit xml at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). Baseline counters can drift because tests create data; use >= assertions or reseed. Referral counter correctly excludes faxed items. Patient-facing statuses correctly mask 'waiting_physician' as 'Under Review'. Storage init works (referral seed PDFs downloadable, custom uploads round-trip).
